mapper.select: SELECT ar.id, ar.name, sc.name AS severity, count( DISTINCT am.id ) as total FROM alert_rule ar LEFT JOIN alert_message_active am ON ar.id = am.rule_id LEFT JOIN alert_severity_conf sc ON sc.id = am.severity_id GROUP BY ar.id

UPDATE alert_rule rule LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t.id, ifnull( GROUP_CONCAT(case methodid
when #{item} then null
else methodid end), '' ) ids FROM ( SELECT id, SUBSTRING_INDEX( SUBSTRING_INDEX( method, ',', ht.help_topic_id + 1 ), ',', - 1 ) AS methodid FROM alert_rule INNER JOIN ( SELECT @rownum := @rownum + 1 AS help_topic_id FROM ( SELECT @rownum :=- 1 ) t, alert_rule ) ht ON ht.help_topic_id < ( LENGTH( method ) - LENGTH( REPLACE ( method, ',', '' ) ) + 1 ) WHERE LENGTH( method ) > 0 ) t GROUP BY t.id ) s ON rule.id = s.id SET rule.method = s.ids WHERE s.id IS NOT NULL

UPDATE alert_rule rule LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t.id, ifnull( GROUP_CONCAT(case receiverid
when #{item} then null
else receiverid end), '' ) ids FROM ( SELECT id, SUBSTRING_INDEX( SUBSTRING_INDEX( receiver, ',', ht.help_topic_id + 1 ), ',', - 1 ) AS receiverid FROM alert_rule INNER JOIN ( SELECT @rownum := @rownum + 1 AS help_topic_id FROM ( SELECT @rownum :=- 1 ) t, alert_rule ) ht ON ht.help_topic_id < ( LENGTH( receiver ) - LENGTH( REPLACE ( receiver, ',', '' ) ) + 1 ) WHERE LENGTH( receiver ) > 0 ) t GROUP BY t.id ) s ON rule.id = s.id SET rule.receiver = s.ids WHERE s.id IS NOT NULL
